comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67. The drive is 1 + 19*clamp(gain + cv*0.1, 0, 1) and the output is clamped to ±10V; the filter frequency is 62.83 + 15645.1 radians per second across the cutoff knob and the resonance is clamped to 0.9. The chorus is a delay line modulated at a fixed slow rate. The panel prints HZ with a note symbol over the quantise switch. CHORUS CV is a threshold at 2.5V that replaces the panel switch, not a continuous control; the chorus itself has a fixed depth and rate. PITCH CV is clamped to 0 to 8V, so negative voltages do nothing.
